title: SCHC Rule 0x08 (TDMA_BEACON) absent from all implementations (spec 02a 2a.2)
description: Requirement (R-02a-003, MUST): 'The root advertises epoch (u32) and num_slots (default 8) via SCHC Rule ID 0x08 (TDMA_BEACON) on CH0.' Classification: divergent — no Rule 0x08 exists in Python (python/src/lichen/schc/rules.py, RULE_ID_UNCOMPRESSED=255), Rust (rust/lichen-schc/src/rules.rs:467 RULE_SET_V3) or C (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c 'rules 0-7 + uncompressed fallback'); spec/appendix-schc.md rule table (lines 24-35) also lacks 0x08. Beacons carry epoch/num_slots as an uncompressed fixed header instead (rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:21-26,83-126). Suggested placement: either add Rule 0x08 to appendix-schc.md + all three SCHC engines, or amend spec 2a.2 to describe the uncompressed TDMA_BEACON header actually implemented; spec Implementation Status line 685 claims Rule 0x08 is implemented — that claim is false. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (docs/spec-coverage.md R-02a-003).
close_reason: Already resolved — verified on main: (1) spec/02a 2a.2 line 36 states 'The beacon is not SCHC-compressed (it is not an IPv6/UDP packet; SCHC would save no bytes on the variable fields)' — the spec was already amended to describe the uncompressed TDMA beacon actually implemented, with the full normative byte layout at lines 38-49; (2) appendix-schc.md rule table correctly omits 0x08 (no dead rule entry); (3) the Implementation Status line already says 'TDMA beacon uses fixed-format uncompressed header (not SCHC)' instead of claiming Rule 0x08; (4) zero '0x08' references remain in the spec body (grep-verified on main and worker1). The R-02a-003 requirement text this bead cites lives in docs/spec-coverage.md (sweep-generated, untracked on main) — its stale 'via SCHC Rule ID 0x08' phrasing never matched the committed spec. All three SCHC engines correctly implement rules 0-7 + 255 uncompressed without a TDMA_BEACON rule, matching the amended spec. No code change needed; closing as resolved-by-spec-amendment.
